# 4-Week Wellness Reset for Sleep, Hydration, Posture, and Stress

A practical, low-cost plan built around your desk job, 3 weekly 30-minute workouts, seasonal allergies, and occasional tension headaches. The goal is steady improvement without overhauling your whole routine.

## 4-Week Wellness Plan

| Week | Focus | Daily Wins | 3x/Week Exercise | Goal by Week End |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Build the base | Fixed wake time; 2 water check-ins; 2 posture resets; 5-minute wind-down | Brisk walk + mobility + bodyweight basics | More consistent sleep timing |
| 2 | Improve sleep quality | Add evening screen cutoff; bedroom cool/dark; morning light exposure | Walk/jog intervals or cycling + core work | Fall asleep a bit easier |
| 3 | Reduce headache triggers | Regular meals; hydration target; shoulder/neck mobility breaks | Strength circuit + stretching | Fewer tension build-ups |
| 4 | Lock in habits | Keep the easiest habits; simplify what failed; plan next month | Your preferred 30-minute routine | A sustainable routine you can repeat |

## Simple Daily Routine

Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/house.svg

### Morning
- Get 5–10 minutes of outdoor light soon after waking.
- Drink a glass of water before coffee.
- Do 2 minutes of neck, shoulder, and upper-back movement.
- If allergies are active, consider a shower or face rinse after being outdoors.

### During Work
- Use a 50/10 rhythm: 50 minutes seated, 10 minutes standing or moving.
- Every hour: 5 slow shoulder rolls, 5 chin tucks, 5 chest-openers.
- Keep water visible on your desk and refill it twice daily.
- Set your screen so the top is near eye level and feet are flat on the floor.

### Evening
- Keep caffeine earlier in the day if sleep is fragile.
- Dim lights and reduce screens 30–60 minutes before bed.
- Do 5 minutes of easy stretching or breathing.
- Aim for the same sleep and wake time most days, including weekends.

## Weekly Exercise Plan

Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/heart-pulse.svg

### Session A — Brisk Cardio + Mobility
- 20 minutes brisk walking, cycling, or similar
- 10 minutes mobility: chest, hips, hamstrings, upper back

### Session B — Strength + Posture
- 2–3 rounds: squats, wall push-ups, glute bridges, dead bugs, rows with a band or backpack
- Finish with neck and shoulder stretches

### Session C — Stress-Down Recovery
- 20 minutes easy cardio at a conversational pace
- 10 minutes breathing, stretching, or a short walk outdoors

## Low-Cost Habits That Help Most

Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/currency-rupee.svg

- **Sleep:** blackout curtain or sleep mask, cool room, consistent wake time.
- **Hydration:** refillable bottle, phone reminder, water before each meal.
- **Posture:** rolled towel or small cushion for lumbar support, laptop stand or stacked books.
- **Stress:** 5-minute breathing breaks, short walks, journaling 3 lines at night.
- **Allergies:** keep windows closed on high-pollen days, wash bedding weekly, rinse face/hair after outdoor exposure.

## Warning Signs to See a Clinician

Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/exclamation-triangle.svg

Seek medical care if you notice:
- Headaches that are severe, sudden, or different from your usual pattern
- Headaches with fever, stiff neck, fainting, weakness, confusion, vision changes, or trouble speaking
- Frequent headaches that are getting more common or waking you from sleep
- Sleep problems lasting more than a few weeks despite consistent habits
- Allergy symptoms with wheezing, shortness of breath, facial swelling, or persistent sinus pain/fever
- Neck pain, numbness, or arm weakness that does not improve
- Signs of dehydration such as dizziness, dark urine, or rapid heartbeat
- Mood symptoms like persistent low mood, panic, or feeling overwhelmed most days
